responsibility: Declares the main state container and APIs for the sym-exec module's per-path symbolic interpretation. It defines value, the bit-vector wrapper owning sequences of value_bit nodes, and state, which maps GCC tree variables to bit-vectors, stores bit_expression path conditions, tracks last condition status, and exposes helpers for declaration, assignment, arithmetic/bitwise execution, condition construction, constant evaluation, origin-based bit complementation, state cloning, and utility creation routines such as LFSR synthesis.
same_name_distinction: Declares the state/value data structures and public/private APIs for per-path symbolic execution, including variable storage, condition management, operation entry points, and origin-based complement helpers. Unlike sym-exec-state.cc, this header defines the containers, signatures, and template scaffolding, not the executable logic that carries out those operations.
